title: Mailbox
description:
Well would you look at that, you found one. And what a wonderful little bundle of joy it is, too. Now, before you can send any mail, you of course need a [mailbox](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/mailbox.png:124:62). Well, I suppose if you're on your lonesome, you'll need two.
Once you place down a mailbox, you'll want to give it a name. This can be anything you want. Do note that it costs 3 levels to create a new mailbox and link it to the network. Once you've done that, congratualtions, you're now ready to start sending some mail.
